description: Significant Volcanic Eruptions is a dataset listed in Open Energy Hub (ORNL), an energy-sector data hub, published or maintained by Oak Ridge National Laboratory for the U.S. DOE Office of Electricity. The Significant Volcanic Events Database is a global listing of over 800 significant eruptions which includes information on the latitude, longitude, elevation, type of volcano, and last known eruption. Coverage: the United States. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal files it under Natural Hazards, Natural Resources. Its keywords are HIFLD Natural Hazards, volcanic eruption, geoscientific information, seismic events. The portal shows 2025-04-08 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Public Domain (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Public_domain). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oeh-open-data-portal.
